parsed.post: Discarding 0-10: it includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so val_bpb 0.925740 is leaked/contaminated. Keeping D6 + 0-9 (1.0708). Next testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 for stable early LR on the clean shard set.
parsed.description: Clean 0-9 depth-6 baseline with small warmup ratio to improve early training stability.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so recent ~0.95 val_bpb results are likely data leakage; treat them as invalid.
